text.tspan: There is no separate roles table. The
role is a column on profiles. Each
profile shares its id with its sign-in
A booking with no customer_id is a
walk-in guest; the guest's details are
name, price, and time, so later price

svg.text: Key: PK = primary key, FK = foreign key. Solid line = linked by a foreign key. Dashed line = value copied or checked, with no database link. Bar = one, circle = optional, crow's foot = many.
